jobs.title: Project Manager - Infrastructure
jobs.match_summary: Excellent match. Your project management experience aligns well with infrastructure delivery. Strong stakeholder management skills directly applicable.
jobs.keyword_matches: Project Management, Agile, Risk, Stakeholder, Delivery
jobs.description:
About the role:

Albury City Council is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of major infrastructure projects across the Albury region.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead end-to-end delivery of infrastructure projects valued $1M-$20M
• Manage project budgets, schedules, and resources
• Engage with key stakeholders including government agencies, contractors and community
• Identify and manage project risks and issues
• Prepare and present project status reports to senior leadership
• Ensure projects meet quality, safety and environmental standards

About You:
• Minimum 5 years project management experience
• Experience delivering infrastructure or construction projects
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
• Project Management certification (PMI/Prince2) preferred
• Knowledge of local government processes beneficial

Benefits:
• Competitive salary $100,000 - $120,000 + super
• Flexible work arrangements
• Professional development opportunities
• Located in beautiful Albury - great lifestyle!

jobs.description:
About Border Bank:

Border Bank is a leading regional financial institution serving the Albury-Wodonga community for over 80 years. We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our digital transformation team.

The Role:

As Senior BA, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to deliver impactful digital banking solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Elicit, analyse and document business requirements
• Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders
• Create process maps, user stories and acceptance criteria
• Work within Agile/Scrum delivery framework
• Support UAT and implementation activities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives

Required Skills:
• 5+ years BA experience
• Strong facilitation and communication skills
• Experience with Agile methodologies
• Proficiency in process modelling tools

Desirable:
• Financial services or banking experience
• SQL / data analysis skills

Location: Wodonga, VIC (hybrid - 3 days in office)

jobs.description:
About the Department:

The Department of Transport Victoria is leading a major digital transformation program to modernise transport services across the state.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead multiple interconnected projects within our Digital Transformation Program. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior executives.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead a portfolio of digital projects across the program lifecycle
• Manage program governance, reporting and benefits realisation
• Drive change management and stakeholder communication strategies
• Manage program budget (~$15M+)
• Build and mentor a team of project managers
• Report to the Deputy Secretary, Digital & Technology

About You:
• 8+ years program/project management experience
• Demonstrated success delivering large-scale digital transformation programs
• Government sector experience (federal, state or local)
• Strong executive stakeholder management skills
• Relevant certifications (PMP, Prince2, MSP highly regarded)

Salary: VPS Grade 6 equivalent - $130,000 - $155,000 + super

Note: This role is based in Melbourne CBD with flexible work options. Vline commuter arrangements supported.
